{"data":[{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.936000","updated_at":null,"id":"e0c3lw2x5m9vjdrk3oqngjj3","character_name":"Courier","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Courier answered the Magical Letterbox in person. He expressed frustration to the party about not having delivered their earlier letters or the loose acorns they had entrusted to him. He produced a handful of loose acorns and the undelivered letter, snatched Bronn Boromir’s new letter, and trudged off down the mountain while carrying all three undelivered parcels and waving his middle fingers.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.821000","updated_at":null,"id":"pahpa4gpeuxnvx9n6ozv5vt3","character_name":"Bogo Boromir","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Bogo Boromir is Bronn Boromir’s uncle. Bronn addressed him as “Uncle BOGO” when composing a message. Bronn used the mountain’s Magical Letterbox to send Bogo a letter stating he had taken down a dragon and demanding pride in the deed.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.707000","updated_at":null,"id":"jyo4bb55tat0qva20e4017pf","character_name":"Sybil","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Merchant Sybil","Sybil's Storefront"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Sybil is the owner of a charred storefront in Byriver. When Bronn Boromir banged on her shuttered door, she answered with a grumbly voice, telling him to "get the fuck out of here" and accusing him of being a looter. She refused to open the door or assist. Later, she approached the Keep with Philip, Tower Guards, and Fireworks Troupe, shouting the party's names and joining those who hailed them as heroes.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:59:52.478000","updated_at":null,"id":"bpma6otgrarkbbwcgjxpy727","character_name":"Pepe","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Pepe is a small companion dragon conjured by Dookeldorn Bludvart.
Dookeldorn summoned Pepe after recognizing his brother's teaspoon in Haldraxis's tea bowl. During a fight with a mountain giant, Pepe contributed to Dookeldorn's attacks, lunging and tearing a chunk of flesh from one giant and later ripping into another giant's backside. On the Keep roof, Pepe added damage to strikes against Haldraxis, was hit by the dragon's fire, and retrieved a distinctive, soaked handkerchief belonging to Dookeldorn's brother from Haldraxis's corpse.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:52:11.886000","updated_at":null,"id":"gddciuzgr9co4vry5zpflas3","character_name":"Clive","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Clive is a Mountain Giants located inside the dragon’s lair. When someone called out his name, a voice from the Steam-Filled Chamber responded. Clive said, “not that” and then, “no. Not your hip again. The healer just did things to that to fix it.” Two Mountain Giants emerged from the steam in response to the call.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:46.128000","updated_at":null,"id":"f99ub9i28mbd1fb1m5zblzpf","character_name":"Haldraxis","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Haldraxis, also known as Hal'Draxas, is a young red dragon the size of a house, known for breathing fire and considered a major threat. Mountain Giants have written fondly about Haldraxis, indicating a bond or dealings with him. Haldraxis attacked and devastated Byriver, extorting gold from the town. He demanded that By River deliver ten thousand gold to Old Temple Ruins and stated he would return daily to wait for the payment. Haldraxis warned that if the payment was not produced by the end of four days, he would destroy the countryside.
During a confrontation, Haldraxis landed on crumbling structures with enormous leathery wings and claws, inspecting the ruins while demanding overdue gold from Gideon Xander and threatening the town. He dodged a collapsing arch but was struck in the gizzard and throat. In a moment of aggression, he lunged at Dookeldorn Bludvart, knocking him prone, and attempted to breathe fire but choked due to his injuries. Wounded, Haldraxis launched into the air and fled over the mountain peaks into the fog, declaring that By River would pay. His flight path led to a nearby lair, where he later lay asleep near a Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold) of approximately five thousand gold pieces, still bearing the earlier wound, snoring puffs of smoke and sipping from a cold, Dragon-Sized Bowl Of Chamomile Tea. Haldraxis also casts an illusion over his dung to alter its appearance.
While asleep, Hal'Draxas was attacked and awakened when his throat was struck again. He roared that the city would burn and fled through the Mountainside Opening toward By River. He later perched on the highest point of the Keep, sighted the approaching party, reared, and began building fire in his throat to incinerate them. He was driven back by covering ballista fire, slammed the roof while pacing, dropped lower, and blasted Bronn, Gideon, and Pepe with dragonfire. He was then struck by a necrotic touch that burst his old wounds, crashing dead onto the roof with a final roar and exhaling smoke as his body went limp.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:46.008000","updated_at":null,"id":"f3e4cxtcwsvi4dm0y56zc3rw","character_name":"Drogba","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Drogba is identified as a barbarian and is confirmed to be dead. Dookeldorn Bludvart stated during a campfire conversation on the first night that he knew Drogba was dead.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.889000","updated_at":null,"id":"fhmwm3fvabxo8eutv9nfzirk","character_name":"Gil","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Gil is a postal carrier dressed in navy-blue robes with a name tag that reads "Gil." He has a worn, unkempt facial appearance. At sunrise, he is magically summoned from a mountain mailbox after a silver is dropped in. He appears startled, puts out his hand, takes Gideon Xander's letter, and begins trudging down the mountain. Gideon hands him an additional sealed envelope that he is instructed not to open; Gil accepts it while expressing that he would have slapped the letter away. Bronn Boromir offers him tea, but he refuses, citing union constraints, and leaves immediately. Later, Gil reappears covered in icicles, carrying two undelivered letters. He accepts a pile of acorns handed to him and gathers them into his pockets one by one before trudging back down the mountain.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.768000","updated_at":null,"id":"vddisocq4o19batalajy9ghx","character_name":"Macy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Macy is a member of the Arcano Academy's group of healing-school students. She frequents the Beachside Mirage bar with Tracy, Lacey, and Stacy. During a recent visit to the bar, she was not at the corner booth; instead, she was searching for an older or more mature gentleman, a detail noted by others when asked about her whereabouts.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.649000","updated_at":null,"id":"mhsosnh3c6vrqhaq0sgzuqrp","character_name":"Philip","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Philip is a human man dressed in a ceremonial guard outfit, consuming fire whiskey and displaying signs of distress. Philip informed E.t. Skittles that a dragon had attacked Byriver and that he was at the resort to recruit wizards, offering a reward of three hundred gold for anyone involved in the dragon's capture or death. He indicated a brooding man in the corner booth as a likely adventurer and encouraged E.t. to recruit that group. Philip approached the booth with E.t. to recruit the group to confront the dragon and visibly relaxed once enough members agreed. He identified the dragon as Haldraxis, a young but dangerous red dragon that breathes fire. He explained that the dragon would return daily to Old Temple Ruins to collect the city's gold, provided each member with a map to the ruins, and noted that the Mountain Route would take two days while the Forest Route would take three. He also distributed healing potions and informed the party that the dragon demanded the city's gold within four days. The party followed Philip's map meticulously to reach the ancient mountain temple ruins where they awaited Haldraxis.
As the kingdom's delegate, Philip wore plumy Swiss-guard garb and remained unarmed, giving direction to the town's Tower Guards and staying at his post by order of the king. At the City Gate, he recognized the party's voices, called them heroes, and ordered the Gate raised. He stated he must remain to defend the Gate due to the expectation of more Mountain Giants and would not rouse the Fireworks Troupe himself. After Haldraxis was killed, he came to the Keep, greeted the party, and thanked them for saving the town. He doubled the promised reward to six hundred gold each and offered free rooms and drinks at the Flaming Wizard Tavern, along with store discounts.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.527000","updated_at":null,"id":"tpzth25uqthvo04p915x205a","character_name":"Luna Starshimmer","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Luna"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Luna Starshimmer is an elf bartender with waist-length midnight-blue hair, eyes that glimmer like starlight, and slightly luminescent skin. She is tall and graceful, wearing scantily clad clothing to attract spring-break tips. At the bar, she approached E.t. Skittles, took his order for mead, prepared it, anticipated the order, set out two meads on the house for E.t. and Philip, and handed the two meads to E.t.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.408000","updated_at":null,"id":"j8fbbyu5qm75wr19uq017bhc","character_name":"E.t. Skittles","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["E.t.","Mister Skittles"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"E.t. Skittles, also known as Eugene Thomas Skittles, is a large turtle-like man who always wears his shell and carries a cane. He keeps loose change and odds-and-ends in his shell and wears an upside-down name tag that reads "wouldn't you to know?". He climbed out of a pool with a drink balanced on his shell, meandered to the bar, and ordered mead. He plucked and ate a feather from Philip's hat, startling Philip, then snapped his cane and struck the bar before introducing himself as Eugene Thomas Skittles. After hearing Philip's offer of a reward for killing a dragon, he agreed to help and accepted two meads from Luna Starshimmer.
E.t. Skittles is a shelled adventurer who carries items in his shell and is armed with a greatclub. He can cast spells and possesses a Cube Of Force, along with a collection of flowers. He later smeared mud on himself, sought red berries to stain himself red, scratched off his name tag, and worked on appearing more dragonlike. He adopted an improvised female-dragon disguise and accepted green dragon dung into his shell, hiding in the ruins while in this disguise. He emerged to attempt to woo Haldraxis, casting a sickening ray but missing, then withdrew. He rushed forward and cast inflict wounds on Haldraxis, opening a necrotic wound. As Haldraxis fled, E.t. Skittles clawed the dragon’s hindquarters.
E.t. Skittles is a member of the party and supported the plan to kill Haldraxis. During the City Gate fight, he made a follow-up attack that missed, unleashed deathly magic that staggered one giant into a dazed state while the other resisted, and then caved in a nearly finished giant with his club. He later failed to finish another giant before Bronn ended the fight. On the Keep roof, he conjured a floating burrito-shaped spiritual weapon and struck Haldraxis with it. He then rushed the grounded dragon and laid a necrotic hand on its snout, causing its old wounds to burst open and killing it. After the battle, he attempted to leave by hang glider, failed to catch the air, and plunged to the ground unconscious. He was revived by Gideon.
Later, he produced and activated a Cube Of Force to shelter the group through the steaming cave mouth. He entered Workshop and initiated an ambush by striking the Mountain Giants with his greatclub. After the fight with the trapped and free giant, E.t. rose and struck the free giant in the head, killing him. To recover from injuries, he consumed one of the collected flowers. He also wove Magical Cache Of Ice Flowers into a lei as decoration. On the mountain, he paid the mountain mailbox to summon Gil, handed Gil a pile of acorns for his raccoon roommates, and sent Gil off carrying Gideon Xander's two sealed letters.","backstory":null,"type":"PC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.287000","updated_at":null,"id":"ehqj5hgueux4r6y4yq9mza9b","character_name":"Brax Thunderbrew","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Brax Thunderbrew is the owner of a tavern. He has a ruddy complexion and bright green eyes, and he wears simple, sturdy clothing suitable for combat and brewing ales.
One evening, he approached Gideon Xander and stated he was done arguing about Gideon's behavior. He ordered Gideon to break up an escalating scene in the corner and to take the large fellow with him. As Gideon left, Brax crumpled the pamphlet Gideon offered and tossed it onto a growing pile of Gideon's discarded pamphlets behind the bar. He noted that the ACs often turned the bar into an inappropriate scene but always had an open tab and spare drinks.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.167000","updated_at":null,"id":"y9pa52hl91d0tqh6coaeoivd","character_name":"Bronn Boromir","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Bronn"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Bronn Boromir is dark-haired, dark-eyed, and notably muscular, resembling a fighter more than a wizard. He witnessed Gideon Xander fall, helped him up, introduced himself, and invited Gideon for a drink. He accompanied Gideon to a corner booth, sat with Dookeldorn Bludvart, rejected Gideon's disguised water, poured real drinks from an abandoned bottle, and toasted with Dookeldorn Bludvart.
When the group left for the Mountain Route, he followed Dookeldorn, proposed using a fake or illusory pile of gold to trap a dragon, questioned E.t. Skittles about his past, and identified himself as a member of the prestigious Boromir Family, noting his lack of their magical talent and wealth. On the mountain, he tested an ice flower by eating it, sprinted forward during a fight with Mountain Giants, used Mage Hand to drive frost flowers into a wounded giant, cut into a giant's rear haunches as it fled, cast Shield to deflect a greatclub blow, attempted Green-Flame Blade and missed, helped loot the Mountain Giants, set the giant encampment on fire, and later offered tea to the postal carrier Gil.
Bronn wielded a greatclub and a dagger wreathed in green flame. He utilized Mage Hand to manipulate objects at a distance. He searched the ruins for lingering arcane traces but found nothing. He examined a damaged archway, selected a removable keystone, and hid nearby. He used his Mage Hand to pull the keystone as Haldraxis passed, but the dragon dodged. During the fight, he hurled a Cache Of Ice Flowers at Haldraxis with his Mage Hand, stepped into the open beside Dookeldorn, and struck the fleeing dragon with his greatclub.
In the Mountainside Cave Carved Like An Enormous Dragon Skull, he entered the Workshop and attempted to determine whether a giant was a prisoner. He stabbed the giant with his dagger wreathed in green flame during an ambush, performed a baiting call imitating an injured giant, crossed the steam chamber, found the escaped giant at a cliff opening, and used telekinetic force to shove the giant, causing it to plunge to its death.
Bronn is a party member who restrained Xander and declared that Haldraxis must die. He delivered a hand-borne bundle of twenty-one Ice-Flower Petals into the dragon's wounded neck and wielded a flame-wreathed greatclub in battle. He received a rapier from freed Tower Guards and later banged on Sybil's charred storefront, claiming to be sent by Philip.
Bronn entered the Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold) chamber and joined the ambush plan, hurling the Ice-Flower Petals into Haldraxis's gizzard/neck, which caused the dragon to roar awake and flee. He fought three Mountain Giants at the City Gate, was struck by a greatclub, and entered a battle-rage. He smashed a giant with his flaming club, absorbed further blows, and pressed his heated club against a giant's ruined backside to kill him. After leaving the Gate fight with the party, he rushed to the Keep courtyard and into the Tower, drank a healing draught on the roof, and hurled a dagger into Haldraxis. After the dragon died, he stopped at a Magical Letterbox to send a boastful message to his uncle Bogo Boromir.","backstory":null,"type":"PC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:45.046000","updated_at":null,"id":"kelnd542lty3owpk9sz8uev5","character_name":"Gideon Xander","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Gideon"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Gideon Xander is a busboy who wears an apron and carries hand-drawn pamphlets about Lathander. He serves at Brax Thunderbrew’s bar, prays to Lathander at dawn, and practices contact juggling as part of his devotion. He serves as an unpaid page under a professor of clerical studies in Lathander’s pantheon and resides in a tiny room. Gideon attempted to grade papers at the bar but was handed a rag and sent back to work. He collided with a guest, spilled liquid, cupped the man’s cheek, told him Lathander loved him, produced a pamphlet, cleaned the spill, and brought him water. He converted a second man in a similar manner while alternating between busing duties and ministering to both. Gideon slipped on a puddle and fell; Bronn Boromir helped him up, and Gideon dismissed his embarrassment, stating the meeting felt like Lathander’s will.
Brax ordered him to break up an escalating situation. Gideon agreed and tried to give Brax a pamphlet, which Brax crumpled. He then went with Bronn to the booth, pushed a tray of shots, addressed the AC women, and persuaded them to take one last drink and leave, serving them water instead of liquor. He left pamphlets behind the bar. Gideon objected to killing a dragon, arguing they should try talking to it. During a mountain-giant encounter, he cast Shield of Faith on Bronn, ran down beside him after the giant was knocked prone, and prayed for Lathander to spare the giant rather than striking it. He chose not to give E.t. Skittles a pamphlet. At dawn, he prayed, performed contact juggling, and wrote and paid to send a letter to two new acolytes, along with a second sealed envelope addressed to Gil, which he entrusted to the mountain postal carrier.
Gideon Xander is a member of the party who burned gathered troll bodies and prayed to the sun to cleanse them. He searched the mountain temple ruins, found two massive dragon prints behind an altar-like throne, and discovered fresh green dragon dung, which he helped load into E.t. Skittles’s shell. He suggested speaking with the dragon, prayed near the altar, and exposed himself to the sun. Gideon walked toward Haldraxis to draw him under the trapped archway, stood and dressed as the dragon complained, and took cover behind a pillar. He invoked a bond between Bronn Boromir and E.t. Skittles, extended that bond to Dookeldorn Bludvart, and supported Bronn when he stealthily cracked the northwest door. In Workshop ambush, Gideon created sparks to distract the Mountain Giants, then stepped forward, took the giant’s head in his hands, and told him to lay down his weapon.
Gideon refuses to harm another living creature and prays to the sun. He gives companions a forehead sun-blessing for guidance. Before an ambush, Gideon touched his companions' foreheads with a sun-blessing. He advanced into the dragon's Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold) chamber while singing to the sun and chose to bolster Bronn instead of attacking during the ambush. After the party landed at By River, Gideon cast a weakening bane on two Mountain Giants and used a one-word command to lull a City Gate-lifting giant to sleep. He placed a hand on a wounded giant, mended a tear in the giant's robe, and told him to be at peace. In the Keep courtyard, Gideon cast Bear's Endurance on Bronn as he ran past, later revived E.t. Skittles after a fall, and urged Philip to rouse the Fireworks Troupe.","backstory":null,"type":"PC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.928000","updated_at":null,"id":"p4navjstuw659zhg1svzii7n","character_name":"Stacy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Stacy is one of three Arcano Academy students from the healing school, alongside Tracy and Lacey. She carried a crystal that she rubbed on a patron's back. Stacy slid into a crowded booth with Tracy and Lacey and asked Dookeldorn Bludvart whether he had been hurt. She directed a calming, comforting healing aura with the other two until Dookeldorn relaxed. Stacy coaxed Dookeldorn to talk about himself and asked probing questions about his scars and wounds. She participated in a shared toast and drinks with the others. When Gideon Xander approached, Stacy protested that they were only trying to heal Dookeldorn. After accepting one final offered round, she rose with Tracy and Lacey and left the booth. Stacy rubbed a crystal on Dookeldorn's back while hugging him and later remarked that the final drinks were "wildly disappointing."","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.804000","updated_at":null,"id":"dffy0ar3t99ao1glrvm9bww6","character_name":"Lacey","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Lacey is a student at the Arcano Academy's healing school. She is one of three students who identified themselves as "Tracy, Lacey, and Stacy." Lacey slid into a corner booth with Tracy and Stacy and participated in a calming, comforting healing aura directed at Dookeldorn Bludvart. She signaled a server, who brought a tray of shots and a bottle. Lacey joined in a toast and drink with her companions. Later, Gideon Xander persuaded the three to take one last round and relocate. Lacey accepted the offered shot but left the booth with Tracy and Stacy when they discovered the drink was water, departing the corner disappointed.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.678000","updated_at":null,"id":"pg6ai18z0ziw7q7ia0rthfsy","character_name":"Tracy","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":[],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Tracy is a student of the academy's healing school. She carries a satchel containing crystals and healing components and, along with Lacey and Stacy, emanates a strong calming healing aura.
Tracy slid into Dookeldorn Bludvart's booth with Lacey and Stacy, pulled out crystals, and hovered one over his injuries to demonstrate healing. The trio directed a pervasive calming aura until Dookeldorn relaxed and began responding. Tracy remained present while the group conversed until Gideon Xander offered one last round; she took a shot with the others and left the booth after that final drink.","backstory":null,"type":"NPC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":false},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:20:44.547000","updated_at":null,"id":"tzrzei1uka9bam2amzdtfrda","character_name":"Dookeldorn Bludvart","character_alias":null,"character_aliases":["Dookeldorn"],"player_name":null,"player_handle":null,"player":null,"description":"Dookeldorn Bludvart is a hooded man who sat alone in a dark corner booth with an empty glass and a Tarp-Wrapped Hovering Object beside him. He was recognized by three students as belonging to Arcano Academy's healing school acquaintances. Dookeldorn Bludvart described joining a mercenary group that included his brother. He experienced violent stomach trouble after a pre-battle feast and returned to find the camp wrecked and his brother missing. He kept a Covered Package from the disaster. He accepted drinks and toasted with Bronn Boromir after Gideon Xander broke up the encounter with the students. Dookeldorn volunteered to pursue the dragon that had attacked Byriver, grabbed his tarp-wrapped package, and took the Mountain Route immediately. He plucked and later crushed and ate Magical Cache Of Ice Flowers in a meadow. During a giant encounter, he fired a Moonbow, initially failing to control its special effect. He killed a fleeing Mountain Giant with a shot, helped destroy the giant encampment, and set that encampment on fire before the party rested.
Dookeldorn is an early-rising party member who forages herbs and carries a crossbow. He returned from nearby brush with foraged herbs and supplies, following Philip’s map through the mountain pass with the group. Dookeldorn chose an elevated perch behind the ruins with his crossbow ready. He tried to spot belongings on Haldraxis and saw no visible sign of them. Dookeldorn loosed a shot into Haldraxis’s gizzard, then fired a second bolt into the gizzard. After warning Gideon Xander, Dookeldorn shifted into a ghostlike defensive state. He was lunged at, clawed, and knocked prone by Haldraxis. Dookeldorn fired another bolt through Haldraxis’s throat at point-blank range and shot Haldraxis again in the rear as the dragon fled. He moved quickly across the terrain, gathered herbs, and kept the group on course while traveling toward Mountainside Cave Carved Like An Enormous Dragon Skull. Dookeldorn proposed luring Haldraxis out and threw Troll Fat into the path of the steaming breath at the cave mouth. He sprinted through the steam chamber, hopped across a narrow flow of lava, and fired a crossbow bolt deeper into the fog.
Dookeldorn is a crossbow-armed member of the party who summoned a small dragon companion named Pepe. He drove a bolt into Hal'draxas's wounded throat, reopening the injuries and jolting the dragon awake. He checked the Mountainside Opening for another shot but lost sight of Hal'draxas. At the City Gate, Dookeldorn fired a crossbow bolt that pierced the throat of a giant forcing the Gate. After recognizing Scorched Teaspoon in the dragon's tea bowl, Dookeldorn called forth Pepe. During the fight with the giant, Dookeldorn missed several shots while Pepe tore flesh from a giant and later attacked another giant. After Hal'draxas fell, Dookeldorn shot the dead dragon in the gizzard and then began looting the corpse while Pepe retrieved the brother's handkerchief. He killed the surrendered giant by driving a crossbow bolt into his remaining eye, desecrated the body, and harvested more Troll Fat. He asked how the dragon had entered Dragon Skull’s Mouth.","backstory":null,"type":"PC","image":null,"tcg_image":null,"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","merge":true}],"total":19,"page":1,"size":20,"pages":1}
